messages:
Eli R: Heads-up 12mo commit conversation with Meridian — they sent traffic profile: peak ~6k req/min chat (baseline 2k/min), embedding batch spikes ~12k/min for 5-10m. Need reserved GPU recommendation + POC plan.
Harper J: Clarify units: 6k/min = 100 RPS peak, bursts to 200 RPS. Which models?
Eli R: Chat -> redwood-2-7b (q4_0). Embeds -> embed-lite.
Kai N: Quick rule: redwood-2-7b @320 tokens (256 in + 64 out) gives ~120-140 RPS/GPU with batching+KV cache. Embeds ~1.2k/min/GPU.
Harper J: Suggest separate pools: chat pool sized for steady + headroom, embed pool for batches. My proposal: reserve 2 chat GPUs (baseline + headroom) and 1 embed GPU. Allow autoscale burst up to +3 GPUs.
Eli R: Does that meet p99 <200ms?
Kai N: Yes with KV caching and preheat. Recommend 5-10min preheat before scheduled jobs. Also enable continuous batching and set per-route latency SLOs.
Harper J: Autoscale sample to include in proposal:
```
metric: chat_rps
scale_up: {threshold:150, add:1, cooldown:60}
scale_down: {threshold:90, remove:1, cooldown:120}
max_replicas: 5
```
Kai N: Tune thresholds after POC. For safety, cap embed autoscale separately so batches don't evict chat GPUs.
Eli R: Pricing approach? Meridian wants predictable spend.
Harper J: Offer 12mo commit covering 2 chat + 1 embed GPU at committed discount (~30%). Include a monthly burst-credit bucket (e.g., 150 GPU-hours) and overage at on-demand. Add clause for scheduled batch windows to avoid surprise overages.
Eli R: Security Qs: they asked about VPC peering, KMS, audit logs.
OpsBot: Security docs: https://redwood.example.com/security/soc2 
OpsBot: VPC peering guide: https://redwood.example.com/private/vpc-peering
Legal-Bot: Note: for Private deployment we can offer customer-managed KMS and extended retention as add-on. Flag this in the response.
Eli R: Meridian requested a 3-day POC next Tue to validate latency and cost. Can SRE support?
Kai N: Yes. Plan two lanes: (1) chat steady + synthetic spikes to validate autoscale and p99; (2) embed batch lane with scheduled preheat to validate throughput and KV warm. We'll produce load curves and expected metrics.
Harper J: I'll draft the pricing sheet and contract bullets. Eli, can you upload the security questionnaire answers here when ready?
Eli R: Will do. Target: post pricing + questionnaire answers by Friday EOD. :thumbsup:
